findings.summary: Pre-existing: a provider read returning a mismatched observation raises FORBIDDEN out of _driver_read; the run is left until recovery or ends INTERRUPTED (provider-caused, not model-caused); follow-up
_plan_digest_changed returns unchanged for a multi-step action without its plan state; earlier checks refuse it, but the guard should fail closed
The worker-path test covers only the connection read and the answer; the other causes share _drive and the kernel liveness test
